categories.main_business_segments: Shanghai ZJ Bio-Tech Co., Ltd. primarily focuses on the research, development, production, and sales of molecular diagnostic reagents and instruments. Their product portfolio includes over 500 molecular diagnostic reagent products across more than 20 series, covering most nationally regulated infectious diseases. The company also offers 11 series of diagnostic instruments, including automated nucleic acid extraction systems and molecular detection platforms, serving clinical diagnostics, public health safety, quarantine, and food safety sectors.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company’s core technologies include proprietary nano magnetic bead preparation, locked nucleic acid and minor groove binder co-modified nucleic acid fragment technology, fully automated nucleic acid extraction, multiplex real-time fluorescent quantitative PCR, and high-throughput sequencing sample pre-processing. They emphasize automation and high-throughput capabilities, integrating flexible robotic arms and microfluidic molecular POCT technologies. Production follows a sales-driven model with strict supplier selection and quality control systems, supported by ISO13485 certification.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include top-tier hospitals, third-party medical testing laboratories, disease control centers, and customs inspection agencies primarily within China. The company’s products are widely used in clinical diagnostics, epidemic prevention, and food safety, with international sales expanding to over 100 countries and regions. Notable end users include Beijing Union Medical College Hospital, PLA General Hospital, Shanghai Ruijin Hospital, and others.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in China with headquarters and production facilities in Shanghai and subsidiaries in Hangzhou, the United States, and Singapore. It has established overseas branches in the US and Singapore and has obtained certifications for sales in countries such as Thailand, Turkey, and Georgia. Export markets account for a growing portion of revenue, with products sold globally.
categories.supply_chain_position: Shanghai ZJ Bio-Tech operates primarily in the midstream segment of the molecular diagnostics supply chain, focusing on the development and manufacturing of diagnostic reagents and instruments. It also produces key upstream raw materials like nano magnetic beads, reducing reliance on foreign suppliers and enabling import substitution. The company’s integrated approach includes R&D, procurement, production, sales, and after-sales service.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes innovation in molecular diagnostics, increasing R&D investment to enhance existing technologies and develop new products such as blood screening nucleic acid kits, tumor companion diagnostics, early cancer screening kits, respiratory pathogen detection kits, and gut microbiome testing kits. It focuses on automation, POCT, high-throughput sequencing, and integration of AI with biotechnology. The company actively pursues international certifications and expands its global market presence.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through direct sales of molecular diagnostic reagents and instruments to hospitals, laboratories, and public health institutions. The company employs a mixed sales model combining direct sales and distribution channels. Revenue streams include domestic and international product sales, with a focus on high-margin nucleic acid testing kits and automated diagnostic equipment.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Shanghai ZJ Bio-Tech is positioned as a leading domestic molecular diagnostics company with advanced technology and a comprehensive product portfolio. It competes with multinational giants like Roche and Abbott in the high-end market but maintains a strong competitive edge in China through its broad product range, rapid response to epidemics, and proprietary technologies. The company is recognized for its contributions to public health emergencies and holds numerous patents and certifications.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenue of approximately RMB 178.7 million, a 34.88% decrease from the previous year, primarily due to reduced market demand. Net loss attributable to shareholders was RMB 127.46 million, slightly improved from the prior year. R&D investment accounted for 32.9% of revenue, up from 22.24%. Total assets were about RMB 3.79 billion with a slight decline from the previous year. The company maintains positive operating cash flow and continues to invest in capacity expansion and R&D.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes quality and service, offering a broad and technically advanced product portfolio with over 500 molecular diagnostic reagents and 11 instrument series. Its proprietary nano magnetic bead technology and automated nucleic acid extraction systems provide high sensitivity, specificity, and operational efficiency. The company’s rapid epidemic response capability, extensive clinical validation, and international certifications differentiate it in the market. It also focuses on automation and integration to reduce complexity and improve throughput for customers.
